items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I made some for Benny Goodman... We made a tour of all the Latin Countries and that was something. That was different from everything else. This was with Benny Goodman you know.

ctx.x: I made some for Benny Goodman. They were, they were all paying nice, pretty nice. A hundred dollars an arrangement. To me at that time, so if I was making two or three arrangements a week I wasn't paying but 35 dollars a week in my hotel and I never did make that money with Basie.
I was also writing for stock arrangements for BVC, Bregman, Vocco, Cann publishers on Broadway.
